symptom: Director TASK-2 corrective retry was qualified with max_tokens=7000 despite a declared output_budget_tokens=128000. The provider exhausted exactly 7000 completion tokens: two write_file calls were complete, while the third was truncated to content-only with no file argument. DEO then fail-closed the malformed mutation as deo_path_scope_denied, leaving src/main.rs and engine targets unmaterialized.
known_facts: The initial and retry Provider requests both carry the correct TASK-2 contract and target files.
The initial model batch targeted TASK-1 paths and was correctly rejected atomically.
The corrective retry emitted three write_file calls; the third call lost its required file argument at the exact 7000-token output boundary.
The final request audit marked execution_strategy_output_budget_under_applied as severity=error and context_needs_review=true, but qualification still permitted the physical call.
The forced-tool retry path overwrote the 128000-token execution strategy budget with the 7000-token create floor.
No target-project write from the denied retry was accepted.
repair_contract: Treat max_tokens_floor as a lower bound even for forced-tool retries; never shrink the declared execution strategy output budget.
Reject final provider qualification when context_quality contains any severity=error finding.
Do not broaden path scope, synthesize authority, bypass DEO, or weaken atomic zero-effect behavior.
Preserve the existing fail-closed denial for genuinely malformed or out-of-scope mutation calls.
required_tests: A forced retry with a 7000-token floor and a 128000-token execution strategy preserves max_tokens=128000.
A final request audit containing a severity=error context-quality finding is rejected before physical provider qualification.
A retry writing a prior-task or unrelated path remains rejected with zero effects.
Retry settlement continues to produce canonical Tool Lifecycle and effect receipts.
